how_to_add_a_frame: 1. In Photoshop: click the eye icon on your Video Placeholder layer to HIDE it
2. Export the file as PNG with transparency enabled (Export As → PNG)
3. Upload the PNG to assets/video-frames/ in your GitHub repo
4. Add one entry to this file under the matching ratio (story/portrait/square)
_instructions.radius: The corner radius of your Video Placeholder layer. Check the Properties panel in PS — it shows the px value. Use 0 if the placeholder has no rounded corners.
